body: Delta Air Lines discontinued 10 international routes between January and October 2026, six of them to Caribbean destinations, with Brussels, Reykjavik, Mazatlan and Vancouver completing the list. Five of the cancellations involve New York's John F. Kennedy International Airport, while Atlanta, Minneapolis and Detroit also lost routes, and nine of the 10 services were operated by narrowbody aircraft, the sole widebody exception being New York JFK to Brussels on the Boeing 767-300ER. US Department of Transportation T-100 data shows eight of the 10 discontinued routes recorded load factors below Delta's 85% international average, the weakest being Atlanta to Kingstown at 50.4%, followed by New York JFK to Kingston at 54.3%. Atlanta to Vancouver recorded an exceptional 95.0%, but it was a once-weekly operation that will continue through daily nonstop flights by WestJet, while the New York JFK to Bermuda service was transferred to LaGuardia Airport. At the same time, Delta added seats on eight established regional international routes, six of them from Atlanta, with Atlanta to Providenciales recording the largest increase at 47.8% while maintaining an 86.2% load factor.

United Airlines removed all flights to seven destinations from its summer 2027 schedule: five domestic airports, Nantucket, West Yellowstone, Rhinelander, Pellston and Sault Ste. Marie, plus Tulum in Mexico and Dakar in Senegal. United began serving Tulum in April 2024 and will operate its last flight there in January 2027, with US Department of Transportation data showing average load factors of only 60% to around 70%. The Dakar service began in May 2025 with three weekly flights from Washington Dulles on the Boeing 767-300ER and was discontinued less than a year after launch, recording an average monthly load factor of just 58% across nine months, with fewer than 40% of seats filled in two of those months. Once United leaves, Delta will be the only airline offering nonstop flights between the US and Dakar. JetBlue, meanwhile, stopped flying to two US airports, Daytona Beach and Manchester, and four international destinations, Antigua, Bonaire, Belize City and Tulum. Its New York JFK to Tulum service carried 91,226 round-trip passengers at a 70.4% load factor, against 83.2% for the airline's overall network from JFK to Mexico, while its activity at Fort Lauderdale jumped 57% year on year and the airport has become JetBlue's busiest, with routes rising from 37 last November to 61 now.

American Airlines is moving in the opposite direction and will add nine new international routes between January and late May 2027, using the Embraer E175, Boeing 787-9, Boeing 777-200ER, Airbus A321XLR and Airbus A321neo. Miami to Samana (El Catey) launches on January 15, three times weekly on the E175; Chicago to Tokyo Narita begins on March 19, daily on the 787-9; and Charlotte to Barcelona starts on March 27, daily on the 777-200ER. Four of the new routes will use the Airbus A321XLR: New York-JFK to Amsterdam and Philadelphia to Porto, both from March 27, and New York-JFK to Nice and Philadelphia to Vienna, both from May 6, all daily. American will also resume New York-JFK to Tel Aviv on March 27, daily on the 777-200ER, its first service to the region since tensions saw major US carriers withdraw; United and Delta have already resumed, leaving American the last of the US legacy carriers to return. Philadelphia to Reykjavik Keflavik, daily on the A321neo, is also among the nine new routes.
en.summary: Delta dropped 10 international routes in 2026, United exited seven destinations and JetBlue six airports, while American Airlines will add nine international routes in 2027, as US carriers concentrate capacity where demand is strongest.
en.title: Four US airlines redraw route maps: Delta cuts 10 international routes as American adds 9

body: 達美航空在2026年1月至10月間停飛10條國際航線，其中6個目的地在加勒比海，另包括布魯塞爾、雷克雅維克、馬薩特蘭與溫哥華；5條航線涉及紐約甘迺迪機場，亞特蘭大、明尼阿波利斯與底特律亦有航線取消，10條航線中有9條由窄體客機執飛，唯一寬體航線為紐約甘迺迪往返布魯塞爾，由波音767-300ER執飛。美國運輸部T-100數據顯示，10條停飛航線中有8條載客率低於達美85%的國際線平均值，最低為亞特蘭大往返京斯敦（聖文森）的50.4%，其次為紐約甘迺迪往返京斯頓（牙買加）的54.3%；亞特蘭大往返溫哥華載客率高達95.0%，但該航線每週僅飛一次，未來由西捷航空每日直飛接手，紐約甘迺迪往返百慕達則改由拉瓜迪亞機場出發。與此同時，達美在8條既有區域國際航線上增班，其中6條由亞特蘭大出發，亞特蘭大往返普羅維登西亞萊斯座位數增幅最大、達47.8%，載客率仍維持86.2%。

聯合航空在2027年夏季班表中移除7個航點，包括美國境內5座機場（南塔克特、黃石、萊茵蘭德、佩爾斯頓、蘇聖瑪麗）以及墨西哥圖盧姆與塞內加爾達卡。圖盧姆航線2024年4月才開航，最後航班訂於2027年1月，美國運輸部數據顯示其平均載客率僅約60%至70%；達卡航線2025年5月開航、每週3班由華盛頓杜勒斯出發，9個月平均載客率僅58%，其中兩個月低於40%，開航不到一年即停飛，停飛後達美成為唯一提供美國往返達卡直飛的航空公司。捷藍航空則停飛美國境內代托納比奇與新罕布夏州曼徹斯特，以及安地卡、波奈、貝里斯市與圖盧姆；紐約甘迺迪往返圖盧姆共載運91,226名來回旅客，載客率70.4%，低於該公司甘迺迪往返墨西哥整體航網的83.2%，而捷藍在勞德岱堡的運量較去年同期成長57%，該機場已成為其第一大機場，航線由去年11月的37條增至61條。

美航則反向擴張，將在2027年1月至5月新增9條國際航線，機型包括E175、波音787-9、777-200ER、空中巴士A321XLR與A321neo；邁阿密往返薩馬納（埃爾卡特伊）2027年1月15日首航、每週3班，芝加哥往返東京成田3月19日首航、每日1班，夏洛特往返巴塞隆納3月27日首航、每日1班。另有4條A321XLR航線：紐約甘迺迪往返阿姆斯特丹、費城往返波多皆於3月27日開航，紐約甘迺迪往返尼斯、費城往返維也納皆於5月6日開航，均為每日1班；美航亦將於3月27日復飛紐約甘迺迪往返特拉維夫、每日1班，這是美航自撤出該市場後首度復飛，聯合與達美已先行恢復，美航為美國三大傳統航空中最晚恢復的一家，費城往返雷克雅維克（凱夫拉維克）每日1班的A321neo航線亦在9條新增航線之列。
zh.summary: 達美航空2026年停飛10條國際航線、聯合航空退出7個航點、捷藍航空撤出6座機場，美航則反向在2027年新增9條國際航線；數據顯示業者正把運力集中到需求較強的市場。
zh.title: 美國四大航空同步調整航線：達美砍10條國際線、美航2027年新增9條
